text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said its analyst Jay Leupp reiterated a buy rating on real estate investment trust Bedford Property Investors, and raised earnings estimates for the company.

-- In a statement, Leupp said he believes Bedford shares are undervalued at a 15 percent discount to their peers, "despite the fact that we estimate the company will grow (funds from operations per share) 43 to 44 percent faster than the peer group average."
-- Funds from operations (FFO) are a common measure of REIT performance. Leupp raised his 1997 FFO estimate to $1.62 a share from $1.56, and raised his 1998 estimate to $1.87 from $1.79.
